title: V-shaped object in the desert turns out to be geese

tellings.quote: can explain like um one of them looked like a V-shaped uh shiny object out in the desert. Turned out it was a flock of geese.

plain: Michael Shermer, a well known skeptic and researcher, told Jesse Michels about something he saw in the 1980s while riding in the Race Across America, a cross-country bicycle race. Out in the desert he saw what looked like a shiny V-shaped object, and he says it turned out to be a flock of geese. He tells it to show how ordinary things can look strange.
